cardArt.title: The American Express® Platinum Reserve Credit Card

product.description: The American Express Platinum Reserve Credit Card is the ideal companion to your Charge Card, giving you the flexibility of a Credit Card, complimentary Travel Insurance and Membership Rewards points.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Long term visa means 12 months or more and does not include a student visa.
eligibility.additionalValue: You are an Australian citizen or permanent resident or hold a long term visa.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Additional Cards are available for any friend or family member 16 years and over.
As a Centurion, American Express Platinum or American Express Platinum Business Card Member, you can apply for the Platinum Reserve Credit Card.
Applications are assessed based on the information provided and are subject to credit approval.

features.additionalInfo: Add up to 4 Cards at no additional fee.
The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
A flexible way to pay off a selected amount or portion of your Credit Card balance in equal monthly instalments. Subject to fees.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.
Up to 55 interest free days on purchases

2.25 Membership Rewards points per $1 spent on all purchases, except government bodies.
1 Membership Rewards point per $1 spent at government bodies in Australia.

Whether it's shopping, dining, travel or entertainment, eligible Card Members can access Amex Offers providing statement credits or bonus points. Amex Offers must be saved to the Card and used for qualifying spend, subject to offer-specific criteria, to receive a benefit.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.
Priority Pass™ membership grants the Basic Card Member 2 complimentary airport lounge visits each year.
Enjoy two complimentary entries per year to The Centurion® Lounge at Sydney International Airport or Melbourne International Airport.

Receive up to US $100 hotel credit and room upgrade (when available) at selected hotels in The Hotel Collection when you book two consecutive nights’ stay through American Express Travel. Subject to availability and eligibility criteria.

Gain status with our partner's loyalty programs. Earn points and enjoy benefits at over 5,600 hotels and resorts within the Hilton Portfolio. Eligible Primary and Additional Card Members are able to enrol in complimentary Hilton Honors Silver elite status. To enjoy these benefits, enrolment is required.

You will receive access to The Centurion Lounge® at Sydney International Airport (T1) and Melbourne International Airport (T2). Your Card grants 2 complimentary single entry passes to The Centurion Lounge® each calendar year (1 January to 31 December). You just need to show your physical Card at the front desk.

discounts.description: $0 Annual Fee if you hold a Centurion, American Express Platinum or American Express Platinum Business Card and meets all other applicable eligibility criteria.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Must hold a Centurion, American Express Platinum or American Express Platinum Business Card and meet all other applicable eligibility criteria.

fees.additionalInfo: Applies to the first 4 Additional Cards
fees.name: Additional Card Fee

fees.additionalValue: When you do not pay the minimum payment required by the due date as shown on your statement.
fees.name: Late Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: 3.5% of the converted amount. Payable when any charge is processed in a currency other than Australian dollars.
fees.name: Currency Conversion Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $6 for each dishonour or debit rejection. Payable if there aren’t enough funds in your nominated account to pay the Card Account or if the whole or part of a payment by direct debit is rejected.
fees.name: Dishonour Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $3 Payable if you pay your Card Account in person at Australia Post by EFTPOS.
fees.name: Over The Counter Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $7 for charges in Australia, $10 for other charges
fees.name: Record of Charge Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable if you or an Additional Card Member requests an additional posted monthly paper statement. You may access statements free of charge through your online Account.
fees.name: Additional Statement Fee

lendingRates.additionalInfo: Interest rate applied to outstanding balances not paid in full by the due date.
